definitions.signal: Last completed five-minute close strictly outside the prior complete NY BBOX; group by whether it is also outside the same-side SessionPath boundary.
definitions.box: 03:30–05:00 checkpoints use the 03–05 forecast. 05:30–08:00 use the 05–08:30 forecast. At 05:00, the qualifying close is 04:55, so it uses the ending first box.
definitions.horizon: Primary: subsequent completed closes through 08:30. Separate next-window: 05–08:30 for first-box anchors; 08:30–16:00 for second-box anchors. These overlap the primary horizon for first-box anchors and must not be added.
definitions.return: At least one subsequent completed candle closes inside the entire prior NY BBOX. The qualifying candle is excluded. A wick touch and final close inside are reported separately.
definitions.limitations: Retrospective reconstructed forecast boxes; descriptive unmatched cohorts with different distances from BBOX. Repeated checkpoints share dates. No causal, independent-sample, or trade win-rate interpretation.
